shapes.name: Title 1
paras: Abstract

shapes.name: Content Placeholder 2
paras: This project presents Timely Sync, a Smart Deadline and Compliance Management System that helps students and professionals manage academic, career, and personal deadlines effectively. It overcomes the limitations of traditional reminder-based tools by providing intelligent risk scoring, impact simulation, and accountability tracking. The system supports manual task creation and smart intake from text, PDF, and images to convert bulk information into structured tasks.

The system follows a modular multi-tier architecture with a responsive frontend, secure backend, and scalable NoSQL database. It integrates in-app notifications, timeline visualization, and behavior monitoring for continuous tracking. By combining academic and career planning in one platform, Timely Sync promotes disciplined time management and improves overall productivity.
shapes.text:
This project presents Timely Sync, a Smart Deadline and Compliance Management System that helps students and professionals manage academic, career, and personal deadlines effectively. It overcomes the limitations of traditional reminder-based tools by providing intelligent risk scoring, impact simulation, and accountability tracking. The system supports manual task creation and smart intake from text, PDF, and images to convert bulk information into structured tasks.
	The system follows a modular multi-tier architecture with a responsive frontend, secure backend, and scalable NoSQL database. It integrates in-app notifications, timeline visualization, and behavior monitoring for continuous tracking. By combining academic and career planning in one platform, Timely Sync promotes disciplined time management and improves overall productivity.

shapes.name: Title 1
paras: Introduction

shapes.name: Rectangle 5
paras: Time management is essential for academic and career success in today’s competitive environment.
Students and professionals handle multiple deadlines, assignments, and commitments simultaneously.
Important information is scattered across emails, notices, learning portals, and social platforms.
Lack of structured planning and prioritization leads to stress, poor performance, and missed opportunities.
Manual tracking methods are time-consuming and error-prone.
There is a growing need for intelligent, centralized, and user-friendly deadline management systems.

shapes.name: Title 1
paras: Literature Review and Objectives:

shapes.name: Content Placeholder 7
table: David Allen – Getting Things Done: The Art of Stress-Free Productivity
Demonstrates the importance of structured task organization and deadline planning for improving personal productivity.
Does not provide automated risk analysis or digital deadline monitoring systems.
Cal Newport – Deep Work: Rules for Focused Success in a Distracted World
Emphasizes focused work habits and time management for achieving high performance.
Lacks integration with automated task tracking and intelligent scheduling tools.
P. Sharma et al. – Student Academic Monitoring and Deadline Management System
Proposes a centralized system for tracking assignments, submissions, and academic deadlines.
Does not include impact analysis, compliance tracking, or behavioral insights.
J. Smith et al. – Deadline Monitoring and Notification Systems for Students
Highlights the role of automated alerts in reducing missed academic deadlines.
Does not support smart document intake or personalized risk assessment.
R. Brown – Behavior Analysis in Productivity Management Systems
Explains how behavior monitoring improves accountability and productivity patterns.
Lacks unified integration with academic and career planning platforms.

shapes.name: Title 1
paras: Existing Systems

shapes.name: Content Placeholder 2
paras: Calendar applications such as Google Calendar and Outlook provide only basic reminders and do not offer intelligent risk analysis or task prioritization based on urgency and impact.
Learning Management Systems (LMS) display academic deadlines but lack facilities for personalized planning, accountability tracking, and productivity analysis.
To-do and task management applications like Microsoft To-Do and Trello support task listing but do not provide impact simulation, compliance verification, or behavioral insights.
Most existing systems do not support smart intake from text, PDF, or images for automatic task extraction.
Current platforms do not integrate academic, career, and personal deadlines within a single unified system.

shapes.name: Title 1
paras: Problem Statement

shapes.name: Content Placeholder 2
paras: Existing deadline management systems do not provide an integrated mechanism for analyzing deadline risks, simulating real-world impacts, and monitoring user accountability. Most platforms focus only on basic reminders and task listing without considering urgency, priority, and consequences. As a result, users often fail to identify critical tasks and manage their schedules effectively.

The absence of intelligent document processing, personalized prioritization, and compliance tracking makes deadline management inefficient and error-prone. Important information from circulars and notices is not automatically converted into actionable tasks. This creates a strong need for a centralized system that supports intelligent decision-making and productivity improvement.

shapes.name: Title 1
paras: Proposed Methodology

shapes.name: Content Placeholder 2
paras: The system is designed using a modular multi-tier architecture.
The frontend provides user interfaces for dashboard, task management, and smart intake.
The backend handles authentication, task processing, risk calculation, and notification services.
Document inputs (text, PDF, image) are converted into readable text using PDFBox and OCR.
Extracted data is analyzed and verified through a review mechanism before storage.
Task information is stored and managed using MongoDB.
A scheduler continuously monitors deadlines and updates task status.
The system generates risk scores, impact indicators, and timeline views for better decision-making.

shapes.name: Content Placeholder 2
paras: Smart Task Intake using OCR and PDF Processing

The system supports document-based task creation by accepting PDF files, images, and plain text. Using Apache PDFBox and OCR, the uploaded content is converted into readable text, which is then analyzed to extract task details such as title, due date, priority, rules, and warnings. This reduces manual task entry and improves productivity.

paras: Coding

shapes.name: Content Placeholder 2
paras: AI-Based Risk Analysis and Failure Prediction

TimelySync includes an intelligence layer that evaluates each task based on due date pressure, priority, impact, and effort. The system calculates a risk score and classifies tasks into Safe, Warning, or Critical levels. This helps users identify high-risk tasks early and take corrective action before deadlines are missed.

paras: TimelySync - Smart Deadline and Compliance Manager is developed as a student-centric platform for managing academic deadlines and time-sensitive tasks efficiently.
It overcomes limitations of traditional planning methods by providing a centralized system for task management, deadline tracking, smart analysis, and productivity monitoring.
The system supports features such as task creation, deadline monitoring, Smart Intake document processing, risk analysis, notifications, and progress tracking.
It offers a simple and organized interface for handling assignments, exams, registrations, workshops, internships, and other commitments.
Smart deadline analysis and document-based extraction improve usability and efficiency compared to normal reminder systems.
The system is tested, and all major modules function correctly, with a modular design that supports future enhancements.
Overall, TimelySync enhances student productivity, accountability, and effective deadline management through a smart web-based platform.
